summary: Accept explicitly declared adaptive aliases consistently at the authenticated gateway

delivery.outcome: Expose and execute exactly operator-configured adaptive model aliases through existing bounded priority/cache logic, while preserving registered route precedence and format constraints.
nonGoals: No provider/credential changes, paid inference, new dependencies, model-class downgrade, existing runtime140 deployment changes or edits to other writers.
Do not change direct-model response_format policy or named application/function semantics.

architecture.decision: Gateway resolves exact aliases from the existing validated adaptive policy and forwards them through its existing direct model dispatcher; reuse established validation/cache/class logic and structured policy errors.
interfaceChanges: Existing model catalog and completion endpoint recognize explicitly declared adaptive alias IDs.
architecture.rollback: Protected revert of gateway alias recognition; no persistent data migration.

commands: python -m pytest -q tests/test_gateway.py tests/test_adaptive.py tests/test_adaptive_priority_cache.py tests/test_health.py
owned loopback real HTTP failover/restart/alias verification
validation.evidence: Reproduce alias rejection before editing; exercise declared/unknown/invalid aliases, catalog deduplication, named-route precedence, format restrictions, actual HTTP credit failover/cache across a fresh process and zero transport on cached exhaustion. Independent exact-head OneDev/Validator publication.
